en: Vintage sepia postcard with two inset photographs framed by floral decorations. The left image shows a long formal dining room (Speisesaal) with a very long table covered in a white cloth, lined with many wooden chairs, an ornate tiled stove, and a large cabinet at the far end. The right image depicts the exterior of a substantial institutional building behind an iron fence and gate, along a dirt road with trees lining the property. Printed captions in German identify the dining hall, an agricultural household school, and the town name Dahlen. Publisher information is printed vertically along the left margin.
